name: agent-guard
description: Guard for dispatching subagents: denies isolation "worktree", checks a declared WORKTREE is a separate, clean, never-dispatched git worktree, and in opted-in repos requires non-read-only subagents to declare one.

requireWorktreeRepos.title: 必须带 WORKTREE 的仓库
requireWorktreeRepos.description: 仓库目录名,逗号分隔;这些仓库里非只读的子 agent 必须写一行 WORKTREE: <路径>(纯调研可写 WORKTREE: none)。也可在仓库里放 .claude/agent-guard.json 开启
